text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The February Stakes begins. The venue's 
electric atmosphere is just like what I 
saw on the news—

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
—With no clear favorite this year, the 
atmosphere is calmer than usual. However, 
it seems we have a very unique lineup of 
Umamusume gathered!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Feels like a whole bunch of oddballs. 
Shinko Windy... is that the girl who 
bites? Lately people are saying she's 
'actually super strong,' but I wonder."

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"Isn't it surprising that Biko Pegasus is 
running, too? That little runt suddenly 
showing up on dirt, I mean. Hahaha, this 
is gonna get interesting!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... After you watch my race, I'll make 
sure you won't even be able to smile.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"There was this insanely strong girl, it 
was unreal"... I'll make them say it...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having arrived at the venue early and 
changed into her outfit, Shinko Windy 
was...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Mmmmmmmm...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Darkness, darkness, the power of darkness 
is an ally of evil... Windy-chan only 
looks ahead...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: —Flash!!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"This strategy really does suit Windy-chan 
best, nod."

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Heh... You truly are... a useful lackey.

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
"'The Biting Umamusume' VS 'The Pint-Sized 
Umamusume', huh...! Ooh~ That's getting me 
fired up!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
The "Queen of Dirt" isn't here, but... 
those two are apparently pretty strong 
too, you know? I can't wait~.

text_block_list.name: Spectator E
text_block_list.text:
...Well, I guess this works too. Haha, 
just try not to hurt yourself, alright~?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
The mood is just as I expected... But I'm 
gonna change that...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Windy-senpai, let's blow everyone away.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: …………Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I definitely... won't lose!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: That's my line!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
The winner will be Windy-chanâ! The 
winner will be meâ!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text: —Huh? You seem really fired up...?

text_block_list.name: Spectator E
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Feels like a serious showdown, 
right...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And just before the race...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... Keep your eyes on Windy-chan, 
got it?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Run faster than anyone, beat Biko too, 
and Windy-chan will...!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Today is the day I overturn everything.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"There's no way Windy-chan's gonna let 
things end like this...!"
